report.incidentSummary: Users reported that the AI assistant quoted an outdated expense ratio of 0.62% instead of the updated October factsheet ratio of 0.55% for 'Kaveri Bluechip Fund - Direct Growth'. Investigation revealed that the monthly factsheet ingestion batch 2026-10 failed schema validation in indexing-pipeline at 2026-10-06T01:35:00Z due to an unknown field 'ter_direct_pct', sending all 214 October factsheet documents to the dead-letter queue. As a result, knowledge-index was never updated with October data and remained on index build 4120. When users asked about the fund, assistant-orchestrator retrieved the outdated September 2026 factsheet (as_of=2026-09-01), causing the LLM to present the outdated expense ratio.
report.rootCauseStatement: The October factsheet ingestion batch (batch 2026-10) failed schema validation in indexing-pipeline due to an unhandled field 'ter_direct_pct', diverting all 214 October factsheet documents into the dead-letter queue. This prevented knowledge-index from updating its index build or document count, causing assistant-orchestrator to retrieve the stale September 2026 factsheet (as_of=2026-09-01) containing the old 0.62% expense ratio.

hypotheses.cause: The monthly factsheet ingestion batch (2026-10) failed schema validation in indexing-pipeline due to an unhandled field 'ter_direct_pct', sending all 214 October fund factsheets to the dead-letter queue and leaving knowledge-index serving stale September factsheets.
hypotheses.rationale: Logs and metrics confirm that 214 documents in factsheet batch 2026-10 were repeatedly rejected by indexing-pipeline due to unknown field 'ter_direct_pct' starting at 01:35:00Z. knowledge-index remained frozen on version 4120 with 18,450 documents, and assistant retrieval logs show queries for Kaveri Bluechip Fund retrieved factsheets with as_of=2026-09-01.

hypotheses.cause: Configuration change CHG-48225 increasing LLM temperature from 0.2 to 0.4 at 04:50:00Z caused the assistant to hallucinate parametric fund details instead of adhering to factsheet context.
hypotheses.rationale: assistant-orchestrator was already retrieving the outdated September factsheet (as_of=2026-09-01) prior to the config change (e.g. at 04:35:07Z). The assistant accurately quoted the data provided in its retrieval context rather than hallucinating.

facts.statement: At 2026-10-06T01:35:00.000Z and subsequent hourly retries through 06:35:00.000Z, indexing-pipeline rejected 214 documents from factsheet batch 2026-10 due to unknown field 'ter_direct_pct' and moved them to the dead-letter queue.
The active index_version on knowledge-index remained unchanged at 4120 and docs_count remained constant at 18,450 throughout 01:00:00Z to 07:30:00Z, with zero alias switches or index rotation events.

assistant-orchestrator consistently retrieved factsheet chunks for 'Kaveri Bluechip Fund - Direct Growth' with as_of=2026-09-01 across the investigation window, including at 04:35:07Z, 04:40:15Z, and 05:05:02Z.
assistant-orchestrator conversation turns made live retrieval calls to knowledge-index and generated responses via llm-provider without serving cached assistant responses.
A configuration change (CHG-48225) applied to assistant-orchestrator at 2026-10-06T04:50:00.000Z updated llm.temperature from 0.2 to 0.4.
job-scheduler executed sip-debit-batch and payout-batch-am, with no factsheet-sync jobs run or failed on job-scheduler between 01:00:00Z and 07:30:00Z.

inferences.statement: Because all 214 October fund factsheets were rejected by schema validation and routed to the dead-letter queue, knowledge-index never received the October update and continued serving September 2026 factsheet data containing the 0.62% expense ratio.
The assistant's incorrect answers were caused by stale context retrieved from knowledge-index rather than LLM hallucination or temperature drift from CHG-48225.

assumptions.statement: The October factsheet for Kaveri Bluechip Fund - Direct Growth is one of the 214 rejected documents in factsheet batch 2026-10 containing the field 'ter_direct_pct'.

timeline.event: indexing-pipeline fails ingestion of factsheet batch 2026-10 (retry 42); 214 documents rejected by schema validation due to unknown field 'ter_direct_pct' and sent to DLQ.
indexing-pipeline retries factsheet batch 2026-10 hourly (retries 43 through 47), failing each time with 214 rejected documents.
assistant-orchestrator retrieves stale factsheet for Kaveri Bluechip Fund - Direct Growth (as_of=2026-09-01) from knowledge-index build 4120.
CHG-48225 applied to assistant-orchestrator, changing llm.temperature from 0.2 to 0.4.
assistant-orchestrator continues retrieving as_of=2026-09-01 factsheet context and answering fund questions.
Support team lead files incident INC-5638 reporting assistant quoting outdated expense ratio 0.62% for Kaveri Bluechip Fund.

confidence.rationale: Logs and metrics definitively demonstrate schema validation failure on all 214 October factsheet documents in indexing-pipeline, failure of knowledge-index to rotate or update beyond build 4120, and continuous retrieval of as_of=2026-09-01 factsheet chunks by assistant-orchestrator.

gaps.description: Specific payload of Kaveri Bluechip Fund - Direct Growth inside the dead-letter queue was not directly inspected due to tool call budget limits.
gaps.impact: Negligible; the entire monthly factsheet batch of 214 documents was rejected, accounting for all fund factsheet updates for October.

recommendedActions.action: Update the indexing-pipeline factsheet schema definition to support the new 'ter_direct_pct' field.
recommendedActions.rationale: Resolving the schema mismatch will allow the October factsheets to pass schema validation.
recommendedActions.verification: Deploy the schema update to indexing-pipeline and verify in logs that factsheet batch 2026-10 validates successfully without schema errors.

recommendedActions.action: Replay the 214 rejected factsheet messages from the dead-letter queue into indexing-pipeline.
recommendedActions.rationale: Reprocessing the DLQ messages will index the October factsheets into knowledge-index and trigger index rotation.
recommendedActions.verification: Verify that knowledge-index index_version increments beyond 4120 and assistant-orchestrator retrieves factsheets with as_of=2026-10-01.

recommendedActions.action: Configure proactive alerting on indexing-pipeline ingest_errors and dead-letter queue growth for factsheet-sync jobs.
recommendedActions.rationale: Factsheet batch failures retried over 40 times unnoticed until support escalated user reports.
recommendedActions.verification: Trigger a synthetic validation failure in non-production and confirm PagerDuty alerts fire within 10 minutes.

candidates.cause: The monthly factsheet ingestion job in indexing-pipeline failed, stalled, or skipped Kaveri Bluechip Fund, leaving outdated factsheets in the knowledge index.
candidates.whyPlausible: Factsheets update monthly on early business days via job-scheduler and indexing-pipeline. findings.summary: The monthly factsheet sync did NOT ingest October factsheets successfully. In indexing-pipeline, factsheet batch 2026-10 failed repeatedly due to schema validation errors: 214 documents were rejected due to an unknown field 'ter_direct_pct' and diverted to the dead-letter queue (observed retries 42 through 47 from 01:35Z to 06:35Z). job-scheduler did not trigger a new factsheet job in this window (only sip-debit-batch and payout-batch-am ran); the sync had already been triggered earlier and was failing on an hourly retry loop. As a result, October factsheets (including Kaveri Bluechip Fund) were omitted entirely from the index.

observations.statement: indexing-pipeline repeatedly failed to ingest the October factsheet batch (batch 2026-10); at 01:35:00Z (retry 42) through 06:35:00Z (retry 47), 214 documents were rejected by schema validation due to unknown field 'ter_direct_pct' and moved to the dead-letter queue.
ingest_errors on indexing-pipeline spiked to 214 errors at 01:35Z and 02:35Z, and averaged 42.8/min across subsequent retry runs at 03:35Z, 04:35Z, 05:35Z, and 06:35Z.

job-scheduler logs had no records for factsheet-sync between 01:00Z and 07:30Z; jobs_running showed activity only for sip-debit-batch (01:00 to 02:30Z) and payout-batch-am (04:30 to 04:44Z), with zero failed jobs recorded on job-scheduler.

Because the entire 2026-10 factsheet batch of 214 documents failed schema validation on 'ter_direct_pct' and went to the dead-letter queue, the updated October factsheets (including Kaveri Bluechip Fund) were never ingested into the knowledge index, leaving the assistant with outdated September factsheet data.

The factsheet sync job was already on retry 42 at 01:35Z, indicating it had been scheduled and retrying long before 01:00Z, retrying hourly directly from indexing-pipeline or a message queue rather than being triggered afresh by job-scheduler in this window.

payload.markdown:
# Investigation report: Assistant quoting outdated expense ratios

**Outcome:** conclusive · **Stop reason:** critic_accepted · **Confidence:** 0.95 · **Written by:** reporting agent

## Summary
Users reported that the AI assistant quoted an outdated expense ratio of 0.62% instead of the updated October factsheet ratio of 0.55% for 'Kaveri Bluechip Fund - Direct Growth'. Investigation revealed that the monthly factsheet ingestion batch 2026-10 failed schema validation in indexing-pipeline at 2026-10-06T01:35:00Z due to an unknown field 'ter_direct_pct', sending all 214 October factsheet documents to the dead-letter queue. As a result, knowledge-index was never updated with October data and remained on index build 4120. When users asked about the fund, assistant-orchestrator retrieved the outdated September 2026 factsheet (as_of=2026-09-01), causing the LLM to present the outdated expense ratio.

**Root cause:** The October factsheet ingestion batch (batch 2026-10) failed schema validation in indexing-pipeline due to an unhandled field 'ter_direct_pct', diverting all 214 October factsheet documents into the dead-letter queue. This prevented knowledge-index from updating its index build or document count, causing assistant-orchestrator to retrieve the stale September 2026 factsheet (as_of=2026-09-01) containing the old 0.62% expense ratio.

## Hypotheses
1. **The monthly factsheet ingestion batch (2026-10) failed schema validation in indexing-pipeline due to an unhandled field 'ter_direct_pct', sending all 214 October fund factsheets to the dead-letter queue and leaving knowledge-index serving stale September factsheets.** — `indexing-pipeline`, data_pipeline_failure, confidence 0.95, supported
   - Supporting: [ev_2, ev_3, ev_4, ev_7, ev_14, ev_15, ev_21] · Contradicting: none
   - Logs and metrics confirm that 214 documents in factsheet batch 2026-10 were repeatedly rejected by indexing-pipeline due to unknown field 'ter_direct_pct' starting at 01:35:00Z. knowledge-index remained frozen on version 4120 with 18,450 documents, and assistant retrieval logs show queries for Kaveri Bluechip Fund retrieved factsheets with as_of=2026-09-01.
2. **Configuration change CHG-48225 increasing LLM temperature from 0.2 to 0.4 at 04:50:00Z caused the assistant to hallucinate parametric fund details instead of adhering to factsheet context.** — `assistant-orchestrator`, config_change, confidence 0.05, ruled_out
   - Supporting: [ev_11, ev_18, ev_24] · Contradicting: [ev_2, ev_7, ev_14, ev_21]
   - assistant-orchestrator was already retrieving the outdated September factsheet (as_of=2026-09-01) prior to the config change (e.g. at 04:35:07Z). The assistant accurately quoted the data provided in its retrieval context rather than hallucinating.

## Facts
- At 2026-10-06T01:35:00.000Z and subsequent hourly retries through 06:35:00.000Z, indexing-pipeline rejected 214 documents from factsheet batch 2026-10 due to unknown field 'ter_direct_pct' and moved them to the dead-letter queue. [ev_7, ev_15]
- The active index_version on knowledge-index remained unchanged at 4120 and docs_count remained constant at 18,450 throughout 01:00:00Z to 07:30:00Z, with zero alias switches or index rotation events. [ev_3, ev_4, ev_8, ev_12, ev_16, ev_22]
- assistant-orchestrator consistently retrieved factsheet chunks for 'Kaveri Bluechip Fund - Direct Growth' with as_of=2026-09-01 across the investigation window, including at 04:35:07Z, 04:40:15Z, and 05:05:02Z. [ev_2, ev_6, ev_14, ev_21]
- assistant-orchestrator conversation turns made live retrieval calls to knowledge-index and generated responses via llm-provider without serving cached assistant responses. [ev_14, ev_17, ev_21]
- A configuration change (CHG-48225) applied to assistant-orchestrator at 2026-10-06T04:50:00.000Z updated llm.temperature from 0.2 to 0.4. [ev_11, ev_18, ev_24]
- job-scheduler executed sip-debit-batch and payout-batch-am, with no factsheet-sync jobs run or failed on job-scheduler between 01:00:00Z and 07:30:00Z. [ev_1, ev_5, ev_10, ev_13]

## Inferences
- Because all 214 October fund factsheets were rejected by schema validation and routed to the dead-letter queue, knowledge-index never received the October update and continued serving September 2026 factsheet data containing the 0.62% expense ratio. [ev_2, ev_3, ev_4, ev_7, ev_15]
- The assistant's incorrect answers were caused by stale context retrieved from knowledge-index rather than LLM hallucination or temperature drift from CHG-48225. [ev_2, ev_6, ev_11, ev_21]

## Assumptions
- The October factsheet for Kaveri Bluechip Fund - Direct Growth is one of the 214 rejected documents in factsheet batch 2026-10 containing the field 'ter_direct_pct'.

## Timeline
- **2026-10-06 07:05 IST (2026-10-06T01:35:00.000Z)** indexing-pipeline fails ingestion of factsheet batch 2026-10 (retry 42); 214 documents rejected by schema validation due to unknown field 'ter_direct_pct' and sent to DLQ. [ev_7, ev_15]
- **2026-10-06 08:05 IST to 12:05 IST (2026-10-06T02:35:00.000Z - 06:35:00.000Z)** indexing-pipeline retries factsheet batch 2026-10 hourly (retries 43 through 47), failing each time with 214 rejected documents. [ev_7, ev_15]
- **2026-10-06 10:05 IST (2026-10-06T04:35:07.924Z)** assistant-orchestrator retrieves stale factsheet for Kaveri Bluechip Fund - Direct Growth (as_of=2026-09-01) from knowledge-index build 4120. [ev_2, ev_3, ev_6]
- **2026-10-06 10:20 IST (2026-10-06T04:50:00.000Z)** CHG-48225 applied to assistant-orchestrator, changing llm.temperature from 0.2 to 0.4. [ev_11, ev_18, ev_24]
- **2026-10-06 10:35 IST (2026-10-06T05:05:02.617Z)** assistant-orchestrator continues retrieving as_of=2026-09-01 factsheet context and answering fund questions. [ev_14, ev_21]
- **2026-10-06 11:30 IST (2026-10-06T06:00:00.000Z)** Support team lead files incident INC-5638 reporting assistant quoting outdated expense ratio 0.62% for Kaveri Bluechip Fund.

## Confidence
0.95: Logs and metrics definitively demonstrate schema validation failure on all 214 October factsheet documents in indexing-pipeline, failure of knowledge-index to rotate or update beyond build 4120, and continuous retrieval of as_of=2026-09-01 factsheet chunks by assistant-orchestrator.

## Gaps
- Specific payload of Kaveri Bluechip Fund - Direct Growth inside the dead-letter queue was not directly inspected due to tool call budget limits. (impact: Negligible; the entire monthly factsheet batch of 214 documents was rejected, accounting for all fund factsheet updates for October.)
- Full LLM completion logs containing the literal '0.62%' string were not logged at INFO level. (impact: Negligible; retrieval logs confirm the September 2026 factsheet (which contains 0.62%) was passed as the grounding context.)

## Recommended actions (not executed)
- **[now]** Update the indexing-pipeline factsheet schema definition to support the new 'ter_direct_pct' field. [ev_7, ev_15]
  - Why: Resolving the schema mismatch will allow the October factsheets to pass schema validation.
  - Verify: Deploy the schema update to indexing-pipeline and verify in logs that factsheet batch 2026-10 validates successfully without schema errors.
- **[now]** Replay the 214 rejected factsheet messages from the dead-letter queue into indexing-pipeline. [ev_2, ev_3, ev_7]
  - Why: Reprocessing the DLQ messages will index the October factsheets into knowledge-index and trigger index rotation.
  - Verify: Verify that knowledge-index index_version increments beyond 4120 and assistant-orchestrator retrieves factsheets with as_of=2026-10-01.
- **[next]** Configure proactive alerting on indexing-pipeline ingest_errors and dead-letter queue growth for factsheet-sync jobs. [ev_7, ev_15]
  - Why: Factsheet batch failures retried over 40 times unnoticed until support escalated user reports.
  - Verify: Trigger a synthetic validation failure in non-production and confirm PagerDuty alerts fire within 10 minutes.

Cited evidence: ev_1, ev_2, ev_3, ev_4, ev_5, ev_6, ev_7, ev_8, ev_10, ev_11, ev_12, ev_13, ev_14, ev_15, ev_16, ev_17, ev_18, ev_21, ev_22, ev_24
